name: loro-batch-richtext-edits
instr:
Please add batch rich-text replacements to Loro so an editor can apply several changes measured against the same version of a text, and recover the removed styled content. Add `loro::TextEdit`, a `#[derive(Debug, Clone)]` struct with public fields `range: std::ops::Range<usize>` and `insert: Vec<loro::TextDelta>`, and the method `loro::LoroText::splice_many(&self, edits: &[TextEdit], pos_type: loro::cursor::PosType) -> loro::LoroResult<Vec<Vec<loro::TextDelta>>>`.

Every range uses the original text in the selected coordinate system. Accept edits in any order and return the removed insert-only deltas in that same caller order. Ranges may touch, but reject overlapping ranges, duplicate start positions, and insertions strictly inside another range. Support `Unicode`, `Bytes`, `Utf16`, and `Event`; reject `Entity`. Replacement deltas are programs of `Insert`, `Retain`, and `Delete` segments. Each inserted segment has exactly its supplied attributes, with missing or null attributes meaning no style, rather than inheriting surrounding marks. Empty segments insert nothing.

Within each range, `Retain` and `Delete` consume original text in the selected coordinate system; `Insert` consumes none. Delete any unconsumed suffix, and reject programs that consume past the range. Retained characters keep their CRDT identities and styles, with supplied attributes patching those styles and null values removing keys. Return the entire original range, including retained characters. On attached
